description: This file defines a Kotlin interface 'NotesApi' which specifies minimal remote API methods for syncing notes, including pushing notes and fetching updated notes since a specific timestamp. It serves as a contract for remote note operations in a note organizer app, with an in-memory implementation for testing or mock purposes.

classes.name: NotesApi
classes.description: Interface defining remote API contract for syncing notes.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Sends a list of notes to the remote backend for synchronization.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Retrieves notes that have been updated since a given epoch timestamp.
